content: It would help to have the cable numbers here. I do not know anymore which cable is which.

replies.content: The brightly colored cable is the RGB LED cable. The other cables all have unique connectors (or clear colors) so you can't connect the wrong one by mistake.

content: At this point, I installed the new zip ties for the buddy board.
When plugging in the offset sensor cable, if you're struggling and can't figure out why, make sure you've cleared out the zip tie you snipped earlier
Tip: Use the small need-nose pliers to hold the offset sensor connector to make it easier to plug in.
